description: Architecture and module ownership requirements for @eliware/redact.

dos: Keep production modules under src/ and mirror their hierarchy under tests/.
Give every module one cohesive responsibility and one reason to change.
Define public exports only in src/index.mjs; internal modules are outside the package contract unless explicitly exported.
donts: Do not combine distinct responsibilities in one source or test module.
Do not expose internal modules as public API implicitly.
